about_the_game:
​Return to the battlefields of Etheria in the new "Returnia" DLC for Dungeon Defenders! Revisit five classic maps, each offering fresh challenges and exclusive rewards:​

  • Return to Mistymire: Brave the dense forests to earn the Forest Mage Staff and the Mini Spider Queen pet.​

  • Return to Moraggo: Navigate the treacherous deserts to claim the Genie's Blunderbuss and the Oni Accessory Set.

  • Return to Aquanos: Dive into the submerged city to wield the Xiphos Blade and befriend the charming Sea Snail pet.​

  • Return to Sky City: Soar among the clouds to obtain the Gem Dagger and the Chainsaw Corgi companion.​

  • Return to Crystalline Dimension: Confront crystalline foes to collect the Constellation Weapons for each hero class.

For the ultimate challenge, complete all five maps consecutively on Nightmare or Ruthless difficulty to unlock the exclusive Baby Old One pet. Gather your allies and prepare for an epic adventure to Etheria's roots with new perils and prizes!
